conclusion: CKRRCCameraStatus +0x84 selects a ring node whose +0x0C field points to an 8-byte bitfield snapshot. Bytes +0x8C..+0x98 are transition indicators derived by comparing snapshots, not verified exposure fields. A separate CKRRCInfoDispData object at 0x10492714 maintains 11 snapshots of 52 bytes and is the stronger candidate for displayed shooting data.
